videos.title: Reactive Streams demand: the publisher sends only what the subscriber asked for
A suspend function becomes a state machine with one small continuation object
In the job tree, failure goes up and cancellation goes down
A thread per connection versus one thread asking a Selector what is ready
Netty's event loop and pipeline: reads flow in, writes flow out, never block
flatMap emits in completion order; concatMap and flatMapSequential keep input order
Cancellation is a request: a coroutine stops only at a suspension point or a check
A cold Flow is a recipe: nothing runs until collect, and each collector runs it again
A Vert.x context runs a verticle's handlers on one event-loop thread, so never block it
Zero-copy with transferTo, then readiness (epoll) versus completion (io_uring)
When the source can't slow down, buffer, drop, latest or error decide what the slow subscriber loses
A dispatcher picks the thread: Default for CPU work, IO for blocking calls, and withContext hops between them
